text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
That's strange... Where did my book on
beadwork
get off to?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I could've sworn it was right here... Yeah,
it's
definitely missing.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I've been so careful about always putting
my
books away in the same place.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I've been focusing on my training
too
much... I'm starting to space out and
forget
things.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
But I can't just leave things like this! If I
chalk this
one up as a loss, what happens
next time?!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I won't stop looking until I find it!
Here,
bookie, bookie, bookie!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute ends up searching for her
book
well into the night.
